name: mutate
description: Generic mutator transform: rewrites tool results via an LLM instruction (translate, summarize, extract, redact…). Enable once, configure per-checkout or per-tool via config_editable. Wraps after-phase.

config.instruction: Translate the human-readable text in this JSON tool result into {{lang}}. Keep the exact same structure, keys, and value types. Leave identifiers, URLs, file paths, code, and numbers untouched. If nothing needs translating, return the input unchanged.
